design.model: ns-3.48 + Padova LoRa PHY, application query/reply scheduler; gapless rearmed single receives model continuous listening. No join, ADR, security MIC or RX1, so not full LoRaWAN MAC or compliance validation.
design.cases: First original seed6100 in all six families, fixed before packet outcomes; selection not based on simulation gains.
design.policies: All9 policies at I05/INDEP80 on budgets.28/.42/.70. Batches frozen from allocation comparison; transport stress, no claim of reoptimized or globally optimal MAC scheduling.
design.geometry: Fixed per family; radii250+(Rmax-250)*sqrt(U), anglesuniform; same per-device geometry at both background loads, scaled radii for range sensitivity. LogDistance exponent3.76, reference7.7dB at1m. No measured calibration, fading or shadowing.
design.timing: One query per selected resource, ID order, downlink spacing hd/duty, reply timeout uses fixed configuredairtime, turn10ms, eachbackhaul25ms. Skip requeststartsafterH, ignore replies arrivingcontrollerafterH. Gateways physicallyhalfduplex in native PHY. No retry.
design.background: 60additional transmitters, each20PHYbytes SF7, ownfixedULchannel, period6s with independent uniforminitialphase; 0.943%airtime/device. Offeredload10packets/s. Geometry fixed withdeploystream; phases paired byfamily/trial acrosspoliciesandsettings.
